name: B10-0500/2025 – § 1 – Am 3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on protection of EU consumers against the practices of certain e-commerce platforms: the case of child-like sex dolls, weapons and other illegal products and materials
part_text: 1. Condemns the recent events in the EU concerning the availability on e-commerce platforms such as SHEIN, Temu, AliExpress, Wish and Amazon of child-like sexualised objects and other illicit or dangerous goods, such as weapons, which were accessible throughout the EU; stresses that these practices constitute a severe breach of EU law and a direct threat to the safety of consumers and the protection of minors;
